Owen bought 12 boxes at $9 each, so total cost = 12 × 9 = $108.  
Each box has 50 masks, so total masks = 12 × 50 = 600.  

He repacked 6 boxes: 6 × 50 = 300 masks.  
He sold these at $5 per 25 pieces.  
Number of 25-piece sets in 300 masks = 300 ÷ 25 = 12 sets.  
Revenue from these = 12 × 5 = $60.  

Remaining masks = 600 − 300 = 300 masks.  
He sold these at $3 per 10 pieces.  
Number of 10-piece sets in 300 masks = 300 ÷ 10 = 30 sets.  
Revenue from these = 30 × 3 = $90.  

Total revenue = 60 + 90 = $150.  
Profit = revenue − cost = 150 − 108 = $42.  

Final answer: 42
